newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to keep "golden share" in CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to keep "golden share" in CVRD.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury will retain a perpetual "golden share" in privatized mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), National Development Bank (BNDES) head Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros said.

Mendonca de Barros told the Senate Infrastructure Committee the BNDES would also hold for five years a golden share in a holding company, called Valecom, to be established with the initial block sale of 40-45 percent of CVRD's voting shares.
A golden share is a power of veto.
Bid specifications for the block sale, due to take place in April, may be published over the next week.
